rule_id.description: Stable identifier for the check implementation.

control_id.description: OSCAL control id this check traces to.

engine.description: opa in v1. inspec, checkov, and cloud-config are reserved.

policy.description: Path to the engine policy, relative to the working directory.

input.description: Optional per-check input JSON, relative to the working directory.

params.description: OSCAL param ids. Values are read from the catalog, profile, or component-definition.

ksi_id.description: Optional FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicator id.

evidence.description: Path to supporting evidence for the report.

evidence_needed.description: What a person must still provide for manual or hybrid checks.

review_status.description: draft means the Rego stub is untrusted. Generation never writes reviewed.

payload_type.description: Enact-owned evidence payload type, for example enact.iam.account-policy.

payload_versions.description: Payload schema versions this check accepts. Unknown versions fail closed.

payload_requires.description: Payload fields that must be present. Missing fields are status=error, not fail.
